construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

input.fixture_label: Required nonempty string; example clearly labeled synthetic
input.questions: 1..20 objects: unique id, text, optional 1..30 keywords
input.sources: 0..100 objects: unique id, title, text, reliability [0,1]; optional origin, locator, positions mapping question ids to support/oppose/neutral

shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, fixture_label, method, briefs; each brief contains question, search terms, attributed evidence, source/origin counts, directional weights, assessment, limitations and recommended next step
shared_schema.error: schema_version, status=error, error; stdout JSON and exit 2
shared_schema.validation: One validate function for API and CLI; strict fields, unique ids, bounded strings and collections, finite reliability, known question references. CLI rejects malformed UTF-8/JSON, duplicate fields, non-finite constants and inputs larger than 1000000 bytes.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single Research functionality: validated input -> lexical passage retrieval -> origin-deduplicated evidence aggregation -> decision brief in the shared output envelope

behavior.retrieval: Unicode case-folded token overlap after fixed stop-word removal. Optional keywords replace question terms. Keep top three matching passages per source, preserving exact quote text apart from surrounding whitespace.
behavior.weighting: Term coverage times caller-supplied reliability. Each origin contributes its maximum weight per stance, not a sum across copies or passages.
behavior.assessment: Positive support and oppose weights yield mixed regardless of majority; one directional weight yields that direction; neutral-only positive weight yields informational; no positive weight yields insufficient_evidence.
behavior.decision_support: Cited quotes, explicit uncertainties, directional evidence assessment and actionable verification/gathering steps, rather than invented factual answers.
behavior.determinism: Stable evidence ordering; no clocks, randomness, network, model calls or mutable input changes

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object, status ok, exit 0; synthetic questions assessed mixed and informational
coverage: CLI success, usage, missing file, malformed JSON and encoding, duplicate keys, non-finite values, oversized input
